newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle light $105/dressed - private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle light $105/dressed - private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sales near midday Tuesday were thin at $104.00 to $105.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady with light trade on Monday, market sources said.
About 1,000 to 1,500 head sold, with some of the sales transacted on a live basis at $64.00 to $64.75, which was $0.25 to $1.00 lower compared with Monday, they said.

Further bids on a dressed basis at $104.00 to $105.00 were passed by some cattle owners who were asking $105.00 to $106.00. Live bids at $64.00 were passed by several owners who priced their cattle at $66.00, the sources said.
